items.text: Today, the DLC characters "Mature" & "Vice" and the latest patch Ver. 2.41 have been released!
DLC Character SYLVIE PAULA PAULA added
DLC Characters AWAKENED OROCHI Team added
DLC Characters South Town Team added
Bug fixes: Fixed bugs that caused freezes.
Some functions have been adjusted and bugs have been fixed.
・Rebalanced dashing input to make it easier
See the patch notes below for details.
＊Issues where players are incorrectly subjected to disconnection penalties will be resolved in a later update.
・Added display settings in the options menu.
・Added keys that can be used hot keyed for the keyboard.
・Resolved crashes when starting the game under certain conditions.
Fixed some minor bugs in the game.
